title: Level 3 Object Focus / Center Table
purpose: Define how cases, entities, concepts, artifacts and dossiers can be centered inside a nested Room without becoming architecture.
invariants: The containing nested Room remains the architectural context while an inhabitant is focused.
Object focus does not change knowledge ownership.
An object may project into multiple Rooms; the focused Room determines the active question.
Object focus must expose type, active Room, other Rooms, public route and evidence/status notes when available.
Leaving object focus returns to the same Room center.
Journey history records object-focus as a distinct transition.

actions.meaning: Open the object's readable public route.
Move the same object into another registered Room projection.
Remove the object from the center table and return to the containing Room.
